in_sanskrit.name: Chagan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chagan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Chagan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chandra’ which means Moon. In Hindu mythology, the Moon God is considered a powerful deity, representing coolness, calmness, and wisdom. The name Chagan is thus believed to bestow these qualities upon the child.
